body: Coordinator trap (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-24 05:03Z, my own slip). In Git Bash, /tmp maps to C:\Users\grzeg\AppData\Local\Temp, which is OUTSIDE the repository. A curl probe with `-o /tmp/x.json` wrote a 1 KB file there, against the CLAUDE.md work-only-in-the-repository rule. I removed it at once and disclosed it to Greg. Rule: for read-only probes use `-o /dev/null`, or pipe to node. Any scratch file goes under C:/github/Personal/TermAl/.tmp/. Never use /tmp, $TEMP or the system temp folder.
